question: How does Maya impose sleep on the bound soul?
premises: Maya produces difference from full consciousness, from Shiva, of the bound
thence only, without perception and action
inference: Maya cuts the bound from full consciousness into sleeplike helplessness.
plain_english: Maya indeed produces difference from consciousness-full, from Shiva, of the bound — imposes a deep-sleep-like state; from that only, perception-and-action-less.
